CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS replenishment_requests (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	request_number VARCHAR(20), 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR(20), 
	notes VARCHAR(1000), 
	created_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	processed_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	processed_at DATETIME, 
	cancelled_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	cancelled_at DATETIME, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(80), 
	purchase_order_id INTEGER, 
	source_purchase_order_id INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_sr_status CHECK (status IN ('open','processing','fulfilled','cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_sr_creator_retry UNIQUE (created_by_user_id, idempotency_key), 
	UNIQUE (request_number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(processed_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cancelled_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (purchase_order_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(purchase_order_id) REFERENCES purchase_orders (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_purchase_order_id) REFERENCES purchase_orders (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_replenishment_requests_source_purchase_order_id ON replenishment_requests (source_purchase_order_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_replenishment_requests_status ON replenishment_requests (status)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS historical_2026_imports (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	public_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	package_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	coverage_start DATE NOT NULL, 
	coverage_end DATE NOT NULL, 
	calendar JSON NOT NULL, 
	summary JSON NOT NULL, 
	source_hashes JSON NOT NULL, 
	provenance JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	confirmed_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	confirmed_at DATETIME, 
	reverted_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	reverted_at DATETIME, 
	reversion_reason TEXT, 
	supersedes_import_id INTEGER, 
	revision_reason TEXT, 
	preview_token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	preview_token_expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	confirmed_slot INTEGER, 
	lock_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_real2026_status CHECK (status IN ('preview','confirmed','superseded','reverted')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_real2026_coverage CHECK (coverage_start <= coverage_end), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_real2026_confirmed_slot CHECK ((status = 'confirmed' AND confirmed_slot IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_slot = 1) OR (status <> 'confirmed' AND confirmed_slot IS NULL)), 
	UNIQUE (public_id), 
	UNIQUE (package_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(confirmed_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reverted_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(supersedes_import_id) REFERENCES historical_2026_imports (id), 
	UNIQUE (confirmed_slot)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS purchase_closure_requests (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	purchase_order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	requested_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	requested_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	decided_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	decided_at DATETIME, 
	decision_note VARCHAR(1000), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(purchase_order_id) REFERENCES purchase_orders (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(requested_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(decided_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_purchase_closure_requests_purchase_order_id ON purchase_closure_requests (purchase_order_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_purchase_closure_requests_status ON purchase_closure_requests (status)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS category_changes (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	category_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	proposed_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	changes JSON NOT NULL, 
	previous_values JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	reviewed_at DATETIME, 
	rejection_reason VARCHAR(1000), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_category_change_status CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES categories (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(proposed_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewed_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_category_changes_category_status ON category_changes (category_id, status)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS historical_2026_products (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	unit VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	cohort VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	identity_status VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	unit_status VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	is_service BOOL NOT NULL, 
	included BOOL NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_real2026_batch_code UNIQUE (batch_id, code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(batch_id) REFERENCES historical_2026_imports (id)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_historical_2026_products_batch_id ON historical_2026_products (batch_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supplier_quotes (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	quote_number VARCHAR(20), 
	supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	issued_on DATE NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	valid_until DATE NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	notes VARCHAR(1000), 
	created_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	replaces_quote_id INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (quote_number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(replaces_quote_id) REFERENCES supplier_quotes (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_supplier_quotes_status ON supplier_quotes (status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_supplier_quotes_supplier_id ON supplier_quotes (supplier_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS historical_2026_daily (
	product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(24, 6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (product_id, event_date), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_real2026_daily_quantity CHECK (quantity >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES historical_2026_products (id)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_changes (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	proposed_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	changes JSON NOT NULL, 
	previous_values JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	reviewed_at DATETIME, 
	rejection_reason VARCHAR(1000), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_product_change_status CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES products (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(proposed_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewed_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_product_changes_product_status ON product_changes (product_id, status)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS replenishment_request_lines (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	request_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	product_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	product_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	unit VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	stock_on_hand INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_sr_product UNIQUE (request_id, product_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_sr_quantity CHECK (quantity > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(request_id) REFERENCES replenishment_requests (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES products (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_replenishment_request_lines_request_id ON replenishment_request_lines (request_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supplier_quote_lines (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	quote_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	product_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	product_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	unit_price NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_supplier_quote_product UNIQUE (quote_id, product_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(quote_id) REFERENCES supplier_quotes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES products (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_supplier_quote_lines_quote_id ON supplier_quote_lines (quote_id)
